method.rule: Adapt the upstream text; do not paraphrase it. Two mechanisms were taken and the compression they exist to serve was not. Upstream compresses to save tokens; this workflow has no such axis, and its records are all persisted, which upstream itself excludes from compression. What transfers is the shape of a style that knows when to switch itself off, and the discipline that a style may never grow its own output.
method.reviewNote: The local corpus had contracts of silence — where not to speak — and no condition under which the register itself changes. `wait-what` was the only route back to plain language and it required the maintainer to notice and ask.

retained: auto-clarity: named conditions under which the style stops and plain form resumes
a security warning, an irreversible action, and a multi-step sequence whose order could be misread each suspend the style
the style suspends when the reader asks to clarify or repeats the question
resume after the clear part is done
the style never grows its own output; it is a substitution, never an addition
false economy is named rather than assumed: a shortening that costs the reader more than it saves is not a shortening
never drop a negation to be shorter
boundaries: anything persisted outside the conversation is written in normal prose
reply in the language the reader writes in, whatever the examples are written in
no self-reference; never announce the style
modified: the axis is comprehension rather than tokens, so no intensity levels are carried: one register switch, held by wait-what
the persisted-outside-chat boundary is this workflow's record/message line, which it already draws; upstream's two sentences state the rule and the existing table states which side a thing is on
repeating the question becomes an automatic trigger rather than only a manual one

notInstalled.reason: Graded token compression. A promotion packet cut by 65% costs a decision that compounds.
It compresses memory files. Every record here is hash-bound, and rewriting one invalidates its receipt.
